title: PandaLog dependency-layer manifest
description: Shape of docs/architecture/dependency-layers.json, the machine-checked package dependency manifest described in 01_SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md §3 and enforced by tests/architecture/dependency-direction.test.ts.

rules.description: Human-readable statement of the rules the architecture test enforces.

layer.description: Partial order only. Packages sharing a layer have no dependency relationship unless explicitly listed.

allowedDependencies.description: The complete set of internal packages this package may import. An import not listed here fails the architecture test.

platformNeutral.description: true = must run unmodified in a browser Worker and under Node: no node:* builtins, no DOM assumptions.

introducedInPhase.description: Roadmap phase (05_IMPLEMENTATION_ROADMAP.md) that introduces the package.
